senses.gloss:
भीम, अस्, आ, अम्, fearful, dreadful, terrible, for-
midable, horrible, horrid, terrific, terrifying; (अम्),
n. horror, terror; (अस्), m. a kind of sorrel (=
अम्ल-वेतस), Rumex Vesicarius; N. of Rudra; of
Śiva; of one of the eight forms of Śiva; of one
of the eleven Rudras; of a Deva-gandharva; of one
of the Devas called Yajña-mush; of a Dānava; of a
Vidyā-dhara; of a son of the Rākṣasa Kumbha-
karṇa; of the second son of Pāṇḍu (also called
Bhīma-sena and Vṛkodara; he was only the reputed
son of Pāṇḍu, being really the son of his wife Pṛthā
or Kuntī by Vāyu, god of the wind; he was remark-
able for his vast size and strength and voracious
appetite; cf. वायु-पुत्र); N. of a Vaidarbha; of
a son of Īlina; of a son of Amāvasu or Āmāvasu
and father of Kāñcana; of a son of Sattvata; of a
king of Dvārakā; of several kings; of an author;
of a poet; of the father of Ananta; (आस्), m. pl.
the race of Bhīma; (आ), f. a whip; a sort of perfume
(= रोचना); N. of a form of Durgā; of an Apsaras;
of several rivers; of a district (probably sacred to
Durgā); of a town.
—भीम-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ,
terrible in act, of terrific prowess; dreadful, destruc-
tive.
—भीम-कार्मुक, अस्, आ, अम्, having for-
midable bows.
—भीम-खण्ड, अम्, n., N. of a
work treating of the Liṅga Bhīmeśvara (mentioned
in the Skanda-Purāṇa).
—भीम-गव, अस्, or भी-
म-गु, उस्, m. (गव or गु = गो), N. of a man;
[cf. भैमगव.]
—भीम-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of
a king.
—भीम-ग्राह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having
terrible sea monsters.
—भीम-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N.
of a king.
—भीम-जानु, उस्, m., N. of a king.
—भीम-ता, f. terribleness, fearfulness, formidable-
ness.
—भीम-तिथि, इस्, f. the day of Bhīma (=
भीमैकादशी).
—भीम-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्,
frightful in appearance or aspect, frightful, hideous.
—भीम-द्वादशी, f., N. of the twelfth day of the
light half of the month Māgha (called after Bhīma
the reputed son of Pāṇḍu; cf. भीमैकादशी).
—भीमद्वादशी-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of the sixty-
fifth chapter of the Bhaviṣyottara-Purāṇa.
—भीम-
धन्वन्, आ, m. ‘having a terrific bow,’ N. of a
king.
—भीम-धन्वायन, ‘bearing dreadful
bows,’ in भीम-धन्वायनी सेना, Mahā-bh. Ud-
yoga-p. 7633.
—भीम-नगर, अम्, n. ‘Bhīma's
city,’ N. of a town; [cf. भीम-पुर.]
—भीम-
नाद, अस्, आ, अम्, sending forth a fearful sound,
sounding dreadfully; (अस्), m. a loud or fearful sound;
a lion; N. of one of the seven clouds which will
cover the sky at the destruction of the world.
—भी-
म-नायक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—भीम-परा-
क्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing fearful power or
prowess; of terrible strength; (अस्), m. an epithet of
Śiva; N. of a man; of a work mentioned in Raghu-
nandana's Saṃskāra-tattva.
—भीम-पाल, अस्, m.,
N. of a king.
—भीम-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town
situated on the Ganges; [cf. भीम-नगर.]
—भी-
म-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing fearful or tremendous
[]
strength; (अस्), m., N. of one of the sons of Dhṛta-
rāṣṭra; of one of Devas called Yajña-mush,
see Mahā-bh. Vana-p. 14166.
—भीम-भट, अस्,
m., N. of a man.
—भीम-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of
an author.
—भीम-भुज, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—भीम-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, of fearful aspect or
appearance; (अस्), m., N. of a monkey.
—भीम-
रथ, अस्, m., N. of a king; of a son of Dhṛta-
rāṣṭra; of Ketu-mat (the father of Divo-dāsa); of
a son of Vikṛti and father of Nava-ratha; of a son
of Kṛṣṇa by Satya-bhāmā; of a Rākṣasa [cf.
भैमरथ]; (आ, ई), f., N. of a river in the
Himālaya mountains; (ई), f. ‘the fearful night,’ N.
of the seventh night in the seventh month of the
seventy-seventh year of life (supposed to be the
ordinary period of human life; a person after this
period is thought to be arrived at dotage and
exempt from all religious observances; भीम-रथी
is probably for भीम-रात्री or for Prākṛt भीम-
रत्ती; cf. काल-रात्री).
—भीम-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्,
of terrible form, of fearful aspect.
—भीम-विक्रम,
अस्, आ, अम्, of terrible prowess, tremendous in power
or strength; (अस्), m., N. of one of the sons of
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—भीम-विक्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fear-
fully powerful or courageous; (अस्), m. a lion.
—भीम-विग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, of fearful form, ter-
rific in appearance, gigantic.
—भीम-वेग, अस्, आ,
अम्, of fearful or tremendous speed, terribly swift
or impetuous; (अस्), m., N. of one of the sons of
Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; of a Dānava.
—भीम-वेग-रव,
अस्, आ, अम्, of dreadful speed and sound, fearful in
velocity and noise; (अस्), m., N. of one of the sons
of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—भीम-शङ्कर, अम्, n., scil.
लिङ्ग, N. of one of the twelve most sacred Liṅgas.
—भीम-शर, अस्, m. ‘having fearful arrows,’ N.
of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
—भीम-शासन, अस्, m.
‘terrible in rule,’ N. of Yama.
—भीम-शाह, अस्,
m. (शाह = شاه ‘the terrible king,’ N. of a king.
—भीम-शुक्ल, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—भीम-
सिंह-पण्डित, अस्, m., N. of a learned man and
poet.
—भीम-सेन, अस्, m. ‘having a terrible
army,’ N. of a brother of Janam-ejaya; of a son of
Janam-ejaya; of a son of Ṛkṣa; of the second son
of Pāṇḍu [cf. भीम]; of a Deva-gandharva; of a
Yakṣa; of a king; of a grammarian; of a phy-
sician; a kind of camphor; [cf. भैमसेनि, भै-
मसेन्य.]
—भीमसेन-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, con-
sisting of Bhīmasena.
—भीम-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N.
of a Brāhman.
—भीमाकर (˚म-आक्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a man.
—भीमा-देव, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—भीमाद्य्-उपाख्यान, अम्, n., N. of the fifteenth
chapter of the Vāsiṣṭha-rāmāyaṇa, commonly called
Yoga-vāsiṣṭha.
—भीमेश (˚म-ईश˚) or भीमे-
श्वर (˚म-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a place sacred to
Śiva.
—भीमेश्वर-तीर्थ and भीमेश्वर-मा-
कात्म्य, अम्, n., N. of two chapters of the Revā-
māhātmya of the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—भीमैकादशी
(˚म-एक्˚), f., N. of the eleventh day in the light
half of the month Māgha; [cf. भीम-द्वादशी.]
—भीमोत्तर (˚म-उत्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Kum-
bhāṇḍa.
—भीमोदरी (˚म-उद्˚), f. an epithet of
Umā.

भीमक, अस्, m., N. of a demon; (also read
भीषक.)
भीमयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. fearful, dreadful.
भीमल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = भीम, q. v.

भीमरिका भीमरिका, f., N. of a daughter
of Kṛṣṇa by Satya-bhāmā; (also read भीमनिका.)
